about: Read from Castle-Leg-Bed-rev-A.pdf (a printed shop plan, no text layer). Every number here is copied off a page; the page is given so it can be checked.

overall.from: p1 What You'll Need; p6 front view; p7 side view

positions: Legs: 3 x 3 at the four outside corners; leg faces 60 x 80 apart (p23 Mattress fit). Two 1 x 4 slots cross in each top, centred: 1 / 1 / 1 (p11).

Rails: 1 thick, centred in the leg slots (x or y 1 to 2 from the outside), tops flush with the leg tops, so 9 to 13 high (p11, p12). Side rail notched from the top, end rail from the bottom, 2 deep, 1 in from each end (p12).
Cleats: 1 x 1 outside each rail, flush with the rail top and the leg faces (p3), between the legs.
Slats: top 1-1/2 below the rail tops, so 11-1/2 (p24 Paperwork). 16 at 2-13/16 gaps, first at 5-13/16 (p23 J9). 1/16 clear of each side rail face (p23).
Slat supports: 1 x 1 under the slats on the inside face of each side rail (p10 Section B-B).
U brackets: on the inside face of each end rail at x 31 to 35 (p23 J11), bottom flush with the rail bottom; 2 x 3/4 notch carries the centre rail flat (p3).

Centre rail: 3/4 x 2 flat, top at the slat bottom (10-3/4), 1/16 short of each end rail (p3). Posts 10 tall, floor to rail (p23: 10-3/4 - 3/4), at the quarter points of the 80 between the legs (p7 side view).

Headboard: 1 boards behind the head legs (y 86 to 87); lower board from the rail bottom (9) up to 29-3/4 at the ends, 31-1/4 at the centre; 1/4 gap; top board 30 at the ends (31-1/2 centre) to 44 (42-1/2 centre), 3/4 radius top corners (p5, p23).

Spacer blocks: 3 x 3 x 1 glued to the back of the head rail under the end cleat (p5), behind the braces. Braces 1-1/4 x 3 x 33 behind the boards, 9 to 42 high, centred 4-1/2 from each side (p23 J11: cap nuts at 4-1/2).
